summary: VersaBank filed a Form 6-K furnishing a press release announcing the appointment of Lawrence Chamberlain as Global Senior Vice President, Investor and Stakeholder Relations, effective immediately. Chamberlain had served as an investor relations consultant to the bank for six years and is transitioning to a full-time executive role. This is a senior management addition, not a forced departure or abrupt change. The filing notes the proposed reorganization as a value-driving catalyst. No deal terms, prices, or advisors are disclosed. The appointment appears routine and strategic, with no indication of controversy or board intervention, thus the categorization as a special situation is conservative and low-confidence.
